Heading: EXT. OPEN SEA - NIGHT (1999)
Description: Prologue. A storm. Fishing boats in the swell and a woman's voice on the radio reading positions.

Heading: INT. COAST RADIO STATION - OPERATIONS ROOM - NIGHT (1999)
Description: Mariamma at the transmitter. Young Anjali asleep under the desk. The lights die.

Heading: INT. SOUNDWAVE STUDIO - BENGALURU - DAY
Description: Present day. Anjali scrubs breaths out of a detergent ad. Fathima calls: Appachan is missing.

Heading: INT. KSRTC BUS - MOVING - NIGHT
Description: The overnight bus to Kochi. Anjali listens to an old cassette of her mother on air.

Heading: EXT. COAST RADIO STATION - DAWN
Description: Anjali arrives. Appachan sits at the foot of the mast with his dog Kannan. Inspector Latha waits by her jeep.

Heading: INT. THOMAS HOUSE - KITCHEN - DAY
Description: Tea with Fathima. The Port Trust notice on the fridge: demolition in seven days.

Heading: EXT. KADALKKARA HARBOUR - DAY
Description: Anjali walks the harbour. Fishermen remember her mother. Suresh runs a survey crew and does not want her there.

Heading: INT. PORT TRUST OFFICE - DAY
Description: Anjali asks for access to the station. The Port Officer refuses. Suresh watches.

Heading: INT. FATHIMA'S TEA SHOP - NIGHT
Description: The school radio club meets over tea. Rahul asks Anjali to look at their homemade transmitter.

Heading: INT. THOMAS HOUSE - APPACHAN'S ROOM - NIGHT
Description: In a clear moment Appachan gives Anjali the station keys. He speaks in Malayalam.

Heading: INT. COAST RADIO STATION - OPERATIONS ROOM - NIGHT
Description: Anjali and Rahul let themselves in. The tape shelves are empty except for one reel dated 14-11-1999.

Heading: EXT. COAST RADIO STATION - NIGHT
Description: A security guard spots their torches. They run. Rahul's bicycle chain comes off.
Tone: the sea before the story. No titles until the static cuts out.
Inciting incident: Fathima's call. Appachan was found at the station.
First turn: the reel dated 14-11-1999.

Heading: INT. FISHERIES SCHOOL - RADIO CLUB ROOM - DAY
Description: Anjali examines the reel. Sticky-shed damage. It has to be baked before it can be played once.

Heading: INT. FATHIMA'S TEA SHOP - KITCHEN - DAY
Description: They bake the reel in a borrowed bakery convection oven, watched like a newborn.

Heading: INT. THOMAS HOUSE - VERANDA - DAY
Description: Appachan mistakes Anjali for Mariamma and scolds her for being late for her shift.

Heading: INT. FISHERIES SCHOOL - RADIO CLUB ROOM - NIGHT
Description: First playback. Static, a laugh, half a sentence in Mariamma's voice. Then the tape stops.

Heading: INT. JOE'S ROOM ABOVE THE TODDY SHOP - DAY
Description: Anjali visits Joe. He will not talk about that night and asks her to leave.

Heading: EXT. ST. ANTONY'S CHURCH - DAY
Description: The memorial mass for the men lost in 1999. Suresh reads the names. Anjali stands at the back.

Heading: INT. POLICE OUTPOST - DAY
Description: Latha warns Anjali about the trespass complaint, then quietly shows her the 1999 file.

Heading: INT. THOMAS HOUSE - KITCHEN - NIGHT
Description: Anjali and Fathima read the file. Fathima talks about her uncle for the first time.

Heading: EXT. KADALKKARA BEACH - DAY
Description: The radio club flies an antenna kite. Anjali teaches them to call the harbour.

Heading: INT. THOMAS HOUSE - APPACHAN'S ROOM - NIGHT
Description: Appachan's bed is empty. The door is open. Kannan is gone too.

Heading: EXT. KADALKKARA HARBOUR - NIGHT
Description: The village searches in the storm with torches. Suresh's crew brings the site floodlights.

Heading: EXT. HARBOUR BREAKWATER - NIGHT
Description: Suresh finds Appachan at the end of the breakwater with Kannan, waving a torch at the sea. He carries him back.

Heading: INT. TALUK HOSPITAL - WARD - NIGHT
Description: Appachan on a drip. Suresh tells Anjali about his father and the Little Flower.

Heading: INT. TALUK HOSPITAL - CORRIDOR - DAWN
Description: An uneasy truce. Suresh gives Anjali one day inside the station.

Heading: INT. COAST RADIO STATION - TAPE ROOM - DAY
Description: In the flooded basement they find the station logbook in a sealed ammunition box.

Heading: INT. COAST RADIO STATION - OPERATIONS ROOM - DAY
Description: The logbook: entries stop at 23:40. 'Main power cut by order. J. D'Cruz.'
Midpoint: Suresh carries Appachan off the breakwater.
Low point: the logbook names Joe.

Heading: EXT. TODDY SHOP - NIGHT
Description: Anjali confronts Joe in front of the drinkers. He walks out to his car.

Heading: EXT. LIGHTHOUSE ROAD - NIGHT
Description: Joe drives drunk. Latha's jeep pulls him over before the bend.

Heading: INT. POLICE OUTPOST - CELL - NIGHT
Description: Joe confesses: the Port ordered the power cut. Mariamma kept going on a battery set.

Heading: INT. COAST RADIO STATION - OPERATIONS ROOM - NIGHT (1999)
Description: Flashback. In the dark Mariamma connects the battery set. Joe leaves. Young Anjali watches.

Heading: INT. FISHERIES SCHOOL - RADIO CLUB ROOM - NIGHT
Description: The second half of the reel plays. Mariamma relays positions. Varghese answers.

Heading: EXT. OPEN SEA - LITTLE FLOWER - NIGHT (1999)
Description: Flashback. Varghese turns the fleet toward the river mouth, then goes back for the Seagull.

Heading: INT. SURESH'S HOUSE - DAY
Description: Anjali brings Suresh the recording. He listens alone to his father's voice.

Heading: INT. PORT TRUST OFFICE - DAY
Description: Suresh asks Krishnadas to delay. Refused. He arranges power for one more night instead.

Heading: EXT. KADALKKARA BEACH - DUSK
Description: The village sets up for listening night: speakers, lanterns, a generator truck.

Heading: INT. THOMAS HOUSE - APPACHAN'S ROOM - DUSK
Description: Appachan dresses in his best shirt and asks where Mariamma is. Anjali tells him gently.

Heading: EXT. KADALKKARA BEACH - NIGHT
Description: Listening night. The reel plays over speakers. Suresh reads the fleet names. Joe stays.

Heading: EXT. COAST RADIO STATION - ROOF - NIGHT
Description: Rahul and Anjali send the broadcast out from the old mast one last time.

Heading: EXT. COAST RADIO STATION - DAY
Description: Demolition. The excavator bites. The mast comes down. Appachan watches without fear.

Heading: INT. FATHIMA'S TEA SHOP - DAY
Description: The radio club paints a sign: Low Tide Radio. Anjali calls Bengaluru and resigns.

Heading: EXT. KADALKKARA HARBOUR - DAWN
Description: The boats go out. On the radio, Anjali reads the weather.

Heading: EXT. KADALKKARA BEACH - DAY
Description: Low tide. Anjali and Appachan walk on the wet sand with Kannan. The end.
Climax: listening night and the last transmission.
